title: Battle of Hastings
summary: Decisive Norman victory over the Anglo-Saxons.
description: Duke William of Normandy defeated and killed King Harold II, breaking Anglo-Saxon resistance and opening the way to the Norman conquest of England.
outcome: Norman victory; William crowned King of England on 25 December 1066.

title: Sealing of Magna Carta
summary: King John seals a charter limiting royal authority.
description: Pressured by rebel barons, King John sealed Magna Carta at Runnymede, establishing that the king was subject to the law and protecting certain baronial and church rights.
outcome: Royal authority constrained; foundation of later constitutional tradition.

title: The Black Death reaches England
summary: Bubonic plague arrives, killing a third to half of the population.
description: The plague landed on the south coast in 1348 and spread across the country, causing catastrophic mortality and reshaping the medieval economy and society.
outcome: Massive depopulation; labour shortages; long-term social upheaval.
